newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound overnight, one-week mixed.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound overnight, one-week mixed.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose in the private sector on Sunday to between 9 1/2 and 10 1/8 percent, from a range of between 9 and 9 1/2 percent on Thursday, bankers said.
Average one-week rates were slightly lower, at between 9 3/4 and 10 1/16, from Thursday's 9 3/4 to 10 1/8 percent.
One of the four big public-sector banks was willing to break the taboo on lending overnight at below 10 1/2 percent, one banker said. "They asked for 10 1/4," he said.
